# T13 collector protocol rasters

These four project-owned PNGs are original output bytes of the T13 recorder's
secondary-raster controls, also retained in the recorder-r5 whole-retention
archive. `origins.json` identifies their source observations. They exercise
only the public Foundation collector protocol; these tests do not establish
independent PDF rendering or qualify the raster algorithm. Actual qualification
remains in the recorder tests and final candidate evidence.
